punchline: Jon Huntsman stayed with the price he had shaken hands on although there was no written contract, lost millions and earned a reputation nobody could buy.
thirty_sec: Adam Grant tells of the businessman Jon Huntsman. He had shaken hands on a large deal, months passed before the contract was signed and the value of the business rose. He could have renegotiated, but he insisted on the price he had shaken hands on and lost millions. In return he earned an unshakeable reputation: his word was more reliable than the tightest contract.
